locations.note: Tanner and Jones go undercover in Calita's South Beach car-theft gang, and Tanner is sent to kill The Gator for betraying it.
Tanner steals cars for Calita, rescues Interpol agent Dubois only to see Jericho kill him with Tanner's gun, and learns the deal will happen in Istanbul.
Tanner tracks Jericho's sale of the stolen cars through the Bagman, cuts off his escape train and is shot by him in an alley.

routes.name: The stolen-car ring
routes.note: Tanner follows the South Beach gang's stolen cars from Miami to the Riviera and on to Istanbul, where Charles Jericho waits.
